story.title: Born from a Distant Star
story.body: The NOVA story began with a clean concept: capturing the fleeting glow of stars in a luxury fragrance bottle. Warm, sandy notes merge seamlessly with bold, dark accents to craft an unforgettable presence.
story.quote: "NOVA is not just a scent; it is the silent signature that announces your presence and lingers in your absence."

items.title: Long-Lasting Projection
items.body: High concentration Extrait de Parfum ensuring your scent lingers throughout the day.

items.title: Rare & Luxurious Accord
items.body: A harmonious fusion of warm amber, muted woods, and subtle dark ink accents.

items.title: Precision Glassware

items.q: How long does the fragrance last?
items.a: NOVA is crafted with a high concentration of fragrance oils, designed to provide a lasting presence throughout the day.

items.q: Is NOVA suitable for everyday wear?
items.a: Absolutely. Its balanced character makes it versatile enough for everyday wear while still feeling special for evenings and occasions.
NOVA combines warm amber, refined woods, and subtle darker accords to create a sophisticated and memorable scent.

items.q: How should I store my fragrance?
items.a: Keep your bottle away from direct sunlight, heat, and humidity. A cool, dry place will help preserve the fragrance.

items.q: Do you offer delivery across the UAE?
items.a: Yes. NOVA is available for delivery across the UAE, with delivery times depending on your location.
